propositions: docs/releasing.md incorrectly describes the pypi environment required-reviewers rule as a second human approval gate, when the sole required reviewer is the configured release identity with self-review permitted and admin bypass enabled
The approval mechanism is non-interactive (pending_deployments REST API call) not an interactive UI prompt, but the runbook instructs operators to approve when prompted
.github/workflows/release.yml line 294 comment repeats the overstated claim of a second human gate and must be corrected to match the fixed documentation

The corrected documentation must specify the complete REST invocation with proper JSON body typing (environment_ids as integer array, not string-typed flag), plus the companion GET to discover environment id

The environment rule's actual guarantee is identity-and-ref control over who can release the publish job, not independent content review; source review assurance comes from Gerrit-reviewed main branch policy already documented correctly
